## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/pdb/pdbsymbol">PDBSymbol</a> defines the base of the inheritance hierarchy for concrete symbol types (e.g.</p>


<p>functions, executables, vtables, etc). All concrete symbol types inherit from <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/pdb/pdbsymbol">PDBSymbol</a> and expose the exact set of methods that are valid for that particular symbol type, as described in the Microsoft reference "Lexical and Class Hierarchy of Symbol Types": <a href="https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/370hs6k4.aspx">https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/370hs6k4.aspx</a></p>


<p>Definition at line 71 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/debuginfo/include/llvm/debuginfo/pdb/pdbsymbol-h">PDBSymbol.h</a>.</p>
